description: Run checker, training scripts and tools (design 5.5, 5.6, 7.1 GPU checks s1-s3, 7.2 preview + smoke commands; OD2 window_steps; OD3 r_level1 128G / 42500; deviations D-c, D-d in plan.md). check_mixed_run gains `--expect-synth-prob` and `--min-task-steps` (both counting `train_<t>/window_steps`) and the BN-recal synthetic-slot check; r_level{4,2,1}.sh gain SYNTH_PROB / SYNTH_JITTER / SYNTH_DEVICE / SYNTH_LABEL_SET / GPU_POLL / MIN_TASK_STEPS (flags emitted only when set, default command lines byte-identical); r_level1.sh defaults become --mem=128G and TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB 42500; sweep SCRIPT_ENV_KEYS; DALI GPU checks s1-s3 in verify_dali_pipeline + slurm/verify_synth.sh; scripts/synth_preview.py + slurm/synth_preview.sh; test-runner lists. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: tests/gpu/check_mixed_run.py: helper `task_steps(recs, t)` = sum of `r['data']['train_<t>/window_steps']` over records (OD2; docstring says records are log windows, not steps). `check(..., expect_synth_prob=None, min_task_steps=None)`: (1) `--expect-synth-prob p` (p in [0, 1]): per task in `tasks`, n = task_steps; mean = sum(window_steps * synth_frac) / n over records holding both keys; PASS iff n > 0 and |mean - p| <= 4 sqrt(p (1 - p) / n) (p 0 or 1: exact equality); result name `synth_frac_<t>`; INFO lines with the window-weighted means of `train_<t>/loss_real` / `loss_synth`; with `expect_bn_recal` and p > 0: from the bn_recalibration event, PASS iff `synth_batches[t] == floor(planned[t] * p)` for every task (name `bn_recal_synth`), INFO with `synth_batches_used`. (2) `--min-task-steps rigid:20,affine:20,deform:80` (parse with a regex like the scripts; ValueError -> argparse error): per listed task FAIL unless trace_counts[t] == 1 AND task_steps >= threshold (name `min_task_steps_<t>`, detail with both numbers). argparse flags + module docstring entries; defaults (None) add no result lines.

tests/test_check_mixed_run.py: tests for both options using `make_run(..., train_fn/train_extra)`: NIT 1 test (4 records x 25 deform steps: `deform:100` PASS, `deform:101` FAIL), a task with 0 executed steps or trace count 0 FAILs, synth_frac within the bound PASS / outside FAIL, weighting by window_steps (unequal windows), p 0 run with synth_frac absent -> FAIL only when the option is given, bn recal synth counts PASS/FAIL, defaults unchanged (existing tests untouched).

slurm/r_level4.sh, slurm/r_level2.sh, slurm/r_level1.sh (identical blocks in all three): env `SYNTH_PROB="${SYNTH_PROB:-0}"`, `SYNTH_JITTER="${SYNTH_JITTER:-0.08}"`, `SYNTH_DEVICE="${SYNTH_DEVICE:-gpu}"`, `SYNTH_LABEL_SET="${SYNTH_LABEL_SET:-synthfine}"`, `GPU_POLL="${GPU_POLL:-false}"`, `MIN_TASK_STEPS="${MIN_TASK_STEPS:-}"`; validate need_float SYNTH_PROB / SYNTH_JITTER (+ awk check SYNTH_PROB <= 1), need_choice SYNTH_DEVICE gpu cpu, need_choice GPU_POLL true false, SYNTH_LABEL_SET =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$, MIN_TASK_STEPS empty or =~ ^(rigid|affine|deform):[0-9]+(,(rigid|affine|deform):[0-9]+)*$ (else die). `SYNTH_ARGS=""`; if is_pos SYNTH_PROB: `SYNTH_ARGS="--synth-prob $SYNTH_PROB --synth-jitter $SYNTH_JITTER --synth-device $SYNTH_DEVICE --synth-label-set $SYNTH_LABEL_SET"` and checker `--expect-synth-prob $SYNTH_PROB`; MIN_TASK_STEPS non-empty -> checker `--min-task-steps $MIN_TASK_STEPS`. Put $SYNTH_ARGS in MAIN right BEFORE $EXTRA_ARGS (EXTRA_ARGS stays last). GPU_POLL=true: in BGR_DRY_RUN mode print one extra line `POLL: nvidia-smi -i <dev> --query-gpu=timestamp,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits -l 5 > $RESULTS/$RUN_NAME/gpu_poll.csv`; in a real run, after `mkdir -p "$RESULTS/$RUN_NAME"`, start `nvidia-smi -i "${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES%%,*}" ... -l 5 > "$RESULTS/$RUN_NAME/gpu_poll.csv" &` on the host before the main singularity call, remember the PID, `trap 'kill $POLL_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT`, and kill it right after main.py returns (design 5.5; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES unset -> device 0). Add an echo line 'synth: p ... | jitter ... | device ... | label set ... | gpu poll ... | min task steps ...'. Header comments: a 'Synthetic contrast (design .agents/tasks/synth-contrast/design.md 5.5 / 7.2)' paragraph with the env names, the rule that the flags appear only for SYNTH_PROB > 0, the GPU_POLL criterion max(memory.used) <= memory.total - 512 MiB, and the paired smoke lines of design 7.2 for that level (with EXTRA_ARGS="--group-config B --lambda-smooth 0.5").

slurm/r_level1.sh (OD3): `#SBATCH --mem=128G`; `TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB="${TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB:-42500}"`; header text: memory paragraph says default 42500 (L1 lr sweep jobs 10541478-10541568 / 10542966: training peaks 37.3-38.9 GB under 42500, the 40000 limit OOMed in d1 backward (jobs 10541465-67)), host RAM MaxRSS ~94 GB so 128G (64G was OOM-killed during the step-500 validation), the fallback threshold sentence adapted (e.g. 'If the smoke peak exceeds 41500 MB, use the fallback MIN_PAIRS=1'), smoke/long usage lines use `--mem=128G`; keep the A100 sentence with TF_MEM_LIMIT_MB=34000. Keep ASCII only.
slurm/sweep_level4.py: add SYNTH_PROB, SYNTH_JITTER, SYNTH_DEVICE, SYNTH_LABEL_SET, GPU_POLL, MIN_TASK_STEPS to SCRIPT_ENV_KEYS (py3.6 syntax: it is a login-node helper).

tests/test_sweep_tools.py: TestScriptsStatic.test_headers: expect `#SBATCH --mem=128G` for R1 and 64G for R4/R2; replace the r1 string checks that changed ('39000 MB' -> the new threshold text) and add '42500', '94 GB'; TestScriptsDryRun.test_r1_default: `--gpu-memory-limit-mb 42500`; new tests: (a) default dry runs of all three scripts contain no `--synth-` flag, no `--expect-synth-prob`, no `--min-task-steps`, and no POLL line (the existing test_r4_default / test_r2_default / test_r1_default sequences must still pass unchanged apart from the OD3 limit); (b) SYNTH_PROB=0.5 (+ CASCADE_FROM for R2/R1): MAIN has `--synth-prob 0.5 --synth-jitter 0.08 --synth-device gpu --synth-label-set synthfine` before EXTRA_ARGS, EXTRA_ARGS still last, CHECK has `--expect-synth-prob 0.5`, `check_parses(main)` passes (runtime.args accepts the flags); (c) MIN_TASK_STEPS=rigid:20,affine:20,deform:80 -> CHECK has it; (d) GPU_POLL=true -> exactly one POLL line and the dry-run writes nothing; (e) invalid env (SYNTH_PROB=abc, SYNTH_PROB=1.5, SYNTH_DEVICE=tpu, GPU_POLL=yes, MIN_TASK_STEPS=deform80, SYNTH_LABEL_SET='a b') -> exit 2 with ERROR; (f) a real (non-dry) run with the fake singularity/nvidia-smi stubs and GPU_POLL=true starts and stops the poll (stub nvidia-smi records its argv). Make sure STRIP_ENV includes the new env names.

tests/gpu/verify_dali_pipeline.py: check 's' (s1 LinearPipeline with label_files: images and T_dali equal the no-label pipeline for the same seed (report INFO if not), labels uint8, (label > 0) == (unwarped image > 0) on >= 99 % of voxels using shuffle=False and the train18-consistent synthfine files; s2 TF render of the unwarped real image with T_mm^-1 (models.layers.transform_image) vs the DALI-warped image: interior mean abs diff < 1e-3; s3 DALI process memory delta with labels at the given level, INFO). New slurm/verify_synth.sh modelled on slurm/verify_m.sh (rtx8000, -A qtim, 1 GPU, 3 CPUs, 64G, 01:00:00; levels 4 and 1; output $PROJ/scratch/verify_synth/verify_synth_l<k>.json; 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval'; usage `sbatch slurm/verify_synth.sh`).

scripts/synth_preview.py (new, py3.8, CPU TF: hide the GPU only via tf.config.set_visible_devices([], 'GPU') at start; never a GPU memory limit): args `--data <export> --level {4,2,1} --n 8 --seed 0 --out <png> [--groups 2] [--split train] [--label-set synthfine] [--prob 1]`; reads n cases' images and `labels_synthfine<sfx>.npy` via the manifest (`data_module.manifest_files`), runs `synth.draw_synth_params` + `synth.synthesize_group` with the training SynthConfig defaults (one contrast per group, G groups), and writes a matplotlib (Agg) PNG grid: rows = real image + G synthetic groups, columns = the n cases, middle axial slice (plus a small sagittal strip optional), titles with the group's blur family/FWHM; prints the PNG path and exits 0. New slurm/synth_preview.sh: `#SBATCH -p basic`, -A qtim, 1 node, 1 task, `--cpus-per-task=2`, `--mem=16G`, `--time=00:30:00`, logs under $PROJ/logs; runs the preview for levels 4, 2, 1 inside the container WITHOUT --nv (`singularity exec -B /autofs -B /cluster -B /space $SIF python scripts/synth_preview.py ...`) writing $PROJ/scratch/synth_preview/<job>/l<k>.png; BGR_DRY_RUN=1 prints the commands and exits 0.
